Visualize Base Phylogenetic Tree

dot-tree_visualize_base.Rd

Draws the base phylogenetic tree with customizable tip labels, node support labels, root edge, rotation, and scale bar.

Usage

.tree_visualize_base(
  tree,
  nodelab_threshold = NULL,
  tree_angle = NULL,
  ggtree_args = list(),
  tiplab_args = list(),
  nodelab_args = list(),
  rootedge = 0.02,
  y.exp = c(0.1, 0.1),
  x.exp = NULL,
  treescale_pos = c(0, -1),
  treescale_args = list()
)

Arguments

tree

A prepared tidytree treedata object.

nodelab_threshold

Numeric or NULL. Threshold below or equal to which numeric node labels are hidden (NA). Default is NULL.

tree_angle

Numeric or NULL. Angle in degrees to rotate the tree. Default is NULL.

ggtree_args

Named list. Additional arguments passed to ggtree::ggtree(). Default is list().

tiplab_args

Named list. Arguments passed to ggtree::geom_tiplab().

nodelab_args

Named list. Arguments passed to ggtree::geom_nodelab().

rootedge

Numeric. Length of the root edge. Default is 0.02.

y.exp

Numeric vector of length 2 passed to expand in ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(). Default is c(0.1, 0.1).

x.exp

Numeric vector of length 2 or NULL. Controls x-axis expansion when non-NULL. Default is NULL (uses package default behavior).

treescale_pos

Numeric vector of length 2 giving c(x, y) coordinates for the tree scale. Default is c(0, -1).

treescale_args

Named list. Additional arguments passed to ggtree::geom_treescale(). Default is list().

Value

A ggtree plot object.

See also
